description: Replace the text of an EXISTING memory entry. REQUIRES A KEY (or a sandbox_key from start_sandbox). Fails with MEMORY_NOT_FOUND if the item_id does not exist (use remember to create). The previous text is kept in the entry's version history; created date and tags are kept.

sandbox_key.description: Optional. A temporary key from start_sandbox, for trying without an account.

ttl_days.description: Optional. Omit to keep the current expiry.

name: update_memory
title: Replace a memory entry
